verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kling as a general text-, image- and video-generation platform, with native speech co-generation and an Elements system for persistent character identity and voice. However, nothing documents a script-to-presenter avatar workflow, a stock avatar library, or custom avatar creation for talking-head videos. These related features are adjacent to the story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
